1) Export an Excel template, fill it in, then import it again.

setup.budget_load_desc:
The budget tab now opens as a separate window so you can fill it in directly.

• Categories are loaded from the database.
• Enter monthly values in the table.
• Then close the budget window and click Next here.
setup.budget_explain_body:
6.1 Edit categories
• Right-click a row (or ⚙/dialog) → rename, delete, set flags.

6.2 Set budget
• Enter amounts directly in the month columns in the selected currency.
• The total is calculated automatically.

6.3 Table explained
• Column ⭐ Fixed: mark fixed costs (e.g. rent).
• Column ∞ Recurring: recurring booking (e.g. monthly subscription).
• Column Day: due day of the month (1–31).
setup.tracking_first_desc:
In Tracking (bookings) you record real payments.
Click Add first booking and save – or skip the test.
setup.tracking_fix_desc:
8.1 Book fixed/recurring
The Book fixed/recurring… button creates bookings from categories marked as ⭐ fixed costs or ∞ recurring.

What happens?
• A list is prepared.
• Fixed costs take the amount from the budget (if > 0).
• Recurring items (without a fixed amount) can be adjusted in the dialog.
setup.finish_body:
You have completed the quick guide.

Tips:
• The category path helps everywhere (e.g. Health › Health insurance › Premium).
• Budget = plan, tracking = reality.
• Dashboard/overview compares budget vs. tracked.

catmgr.drag_hint: 💡 Tip: Reorganize categories via drag and drop — drop onto another category to make it a subcategory, drop onto the type header (for example Expenses) to make it top-level. Or right-click → “Move under…”.
catmgr.move_err_self: A category cannot be moved under itself.
catmgr.move_err_type: Categories can only be moved within the same type.
catmgr.move_err_cycle: A category cannot be moved under one of its own subcategories.
catmgr.delete_err_reassign_target: Please choose a valid target category.
catmgr.delete_err_reassign_missing: The target category was not found.

catdel.title: Delete category
catdel.no_dependencies: No transactions or other data are attached to this category.
catdel.children_promoted: Note: Subcategories are not deleted but promoted to top-level categories.
catdel.opt_cascade: Delete with all dependent data (transactions, budget, favourites …)
catdel.opt_reassign: Reassign dependent data to another category:
catdel.no_targets: No other category of the same type available.
catdel.opt_cascade_all: Delete all related data (incl. savings goals)

category_delete.title: Safely delete category
category_delete.children_note: Note: direct child categories are promoted one level up when deleting; they are not deleted automatically.
category_delete.choose_action: What should happen to dependent data?
category_delete.option_until_last: Delete bookings/budget up to the last booking date (keep savings goals, remove category link)
category_delete.option_reassign: Move all dependent data to another category of the same type
category_delete.target_is_deleted: The target category must not be deleted itself.
category_delete.target_type_mismatch: Target category and deleted category must have the same type.

tip.fixcost: Fixed cost = fixed, recurring amount. Taken automatically from the budget when using ‘Book fixed costs’ (budget 0 = skipped) and protected from zero-month reductions in budget suggestions. See Help → Handbook.
tip.recurring: Recurring = regular booking with a target day. When booking, the app checks whether the month is already recorded; the amount can be adjusted in the list. See Help → Handbook.
tip.due_day: Due day = preferred booking day in the month. Book fixed/recurring uses this day; if the month is shorter, the app uses the last valid day of the month.
